description: This PHP source file defines the ConfigMapperManager class, which manages plugins for configuration translation in Drupal. It handles plugin discovery, instantiation, and processing related to configuration translation mappers, including cache management and translatability checks.

classes.name: ConfigMapperManager
classes.description: Manages plugins for configuration translation mappers, including discovery, instantiation, and cache management within Drupal.

methods.name: getMappers
methods.description: Returns an array of mapper instances, optionally associating them with a route collection.

methods.name: processDefinition
methods.description: Validates plugin definitions, ensuring they contain a 'base_route_name'.

methods.name: buildDataDefinition
methods.description: Builds a data definition using the typed config manager.

methods.name: findDefinitions
methods.description: Discovers plugin definitions via YAML files in modules and themes, processes them, and filters out invalid providers.

methods.name: hasTranslatable
methods.description: Checks if a configuration item has translatable elements.

methods.name: findTranslatable
methods.description: Recursively determines if a typed data element contains translatable parts.

methods.name: clearCachedDefinitions
methods.description: Clears cached plugin definitions for all languages.
